about: Security pitfall catalogue for scan_pitfalls.py, organised by CWE. Each entry is a pattern-level lead: a match is a candidate until a source-to-sink path is traced. cvss_hint is a typical CVSS v4.0 base vector for the weakness, to adjust per finding. tools maps rules from other scanners (tool:rule) to the entry. OWASP categories are the 2025 Top 10.

owasp_2025.A08: A08:2025 Software or Data Integrity Failures
owasp_2025.A09: A09:2025 Security Logging and Alerting Failures

pitfalls.title: SQL built with an f-string
pitfalls.fix: Pass values as bound parameters (?, %s, :name). Identifiers (columns, ORDER BY) must come from an allow-list, never from input.

pitfalls.title: SQL built by concatenation or % / .format()
pitfalls.fix: Use bound parameters; build identifiers from an allow-list.

pitfalls.title: Shell command execution
pitfalls.fix: Call subprocess with an argument list and shell=False; never interpolate input into a command string.

pitfalls.title: eval/exec of a runtime string
pitfalls.fix: Parse data with json or ast.literal_eval; never evaluate input.

pitfalls.owasp: A08:2025 Software or Data Integrity Failures
pitfalls.title: Unsafe deserialisation (pickle, marshal, shelve)
pitfalls.fix: Use JSON (or a schema-validated format) for untrusted data; sign and verify anything that must round-trip.

pitfalls.owasp: A08:2025 Software or Data Integrity Failures
pitfalls.title: yaml.load with an unsafe loader
pitfalls.fix: Use yaml.safe_load.

pitfalls.title: Template rendered from a runtime string
pitfalls.fix: Render fixed template files and pass input as variables; never concatenate input into template source.

pitfalls.title: Auto-escaping bypassed (mark_safe / Markup)
pitfalls.fix: Keep auto-escaping on; sanitise rich text with an allow-list sanitiser (bleach/nh3).

pitfalls.title: File opened or served from a runtime path
pitfalls.fix: Serve with send_from_directory / safe_join, or resolve the path and check it stays under the base directory; prefer opaque IDs.

pitfalls.title: Archive extracted without member checks (zip slip)
pitfalls.fix: Use tarfile filter="data" (3.12+) or validate each member path before extracting.

pitfalls.title: Outbound request to a runtime URL
pitfalls.fix: Allow-list destination hosts; resolve and reject private, loopback and link-local addresses (169.254.169.254); disable redirects or re-check them.

pitfalls.title: Redirect to a runtime URL
pitfalls.fix: Redirect only to relative paths or an allow-list (url_has_allowed_host_and_scheme in Django).

pitfalls.title: Debug mode enabled
pitfalls.fix: Read debug from the environment and default to off; never ship the Werkzeug debugger.

pitfalls.title: Non-cryptographic random used for a security value
pitfalls.fix: Use secrets.token_urlsafe / secrets.choice.

pitfalls.title: Weak hash or cipher for a security purpose
pitfalls.fix: Passwords: argon2/bcrypt/scrypt. Integrity: SHA-256+ or HMAC. Encryption: AES-GCM via a vetted library.

pitfalls.title: TLS certificate verification disabled
pitfalls.fix: Keep verification on; point verify= at a CA bundle for private CAs.

pitfalls.owasp: A09:2025 Security Logging and Alerting Failures
pitfalls.title: Credential or token written to a log
pitfalls.fix: Never log credentials; log the event and a user id. Add a redacting log filter as a backstop.

pitfalls.title: XML parsed with a parser that may resolve entities
pitfalls.fix: Use defusedxml, or lxml with resolve_entities=False and no_network=True.

pitfalls.title: JWT decoded without verifying the signature
pitfalls.fix: Verify with a fixed algorithm list and the expected key, audience and issuer.

pitfalls.title: Request fields copied onto a model without an allow-list
pitfalls.fix: Copy only allow-listed fields (a schema/serializer with explicit fields); never owner_id, role or status.

pitfalls.title: CSRF protection disabled
pitfalls.fix: Keep CSRF protection on for cookie-authenticated state-changing routes.

pitfalls.title: Authentication bypass or extra roles controlled by an environment variable, with no environment guard
pitfalls.fix: Remove the bypass from deployed code, or make it fail closed: accept the static token or extra roles only when an explicit local-environment setting is on, and refuse to start with it in any other environment.

pitfalls.title: Uploaded file read whole into memory (or handed to a parser) with no size limit
pitfalls.fix: Read in bounded chunks and stop past a limit (or set the server/proxy body limit), and check the size before parsing; parsers such as openpyxl also expand compressed content, so cap that too.

pitfalls.title: SQL built with a template literal or concatenation
pitfalls.fix: Use placeholders ($1, ?) or the query builder; Prisma: the $queryRaw tagged template, never the Unsafe variants or Prisma.raw with input.

pitfalls.title: Shell command built from runtime values
pitfalls.fix: Use execFile/spawn with an argument array and no shell.

pitfalls.title: eval, new Function or string timers
pitfalls.fix: Parse data with JSON.parse; never evaluate input.

pitfalls.title: HTML sink that bypasses escaping
pitfalls.fix: Render text with textContent / framework binding; sanitise unavoidable HTML with DOMPurify.

pitfalls.title: Redirect to a runtime URL (res.redirect, NextResponse.redirect, redirect(), router.push)
pitfalls.fix: Redirect only to relative paths or an allow-list of hosts.

pitfalls.title: Outbound request to a URL taken from the request (Express or Next.js sources)
pitfalls.fix: Allow-list hosts; block private, loopback and link-local addresses after DNS resolution.

pitfalls.title: File path built from request input
pitfalls.fix: Resolve against a base directory and check the result stays inside it; prefer opaque IDs.

pitfalls.owasp: A08:2025 Software or Data Integrity Failures
pitfalls.title: Deep merge of request data (prototype pollution)
pitfalls.fix: Validate input against a schema; merge into Object.create(null) or reject __proto__/constructor/prototype keys.

pitfalls.title: NoSQL query built from raw request objects
pitfalls.fix: Cast fields to expected primitive types (or validate with a schema) and use mongo-sanitize.

pitfalls.title: JWT accepted without proper verification
pitfalls.fix: Use jwt.verify with a fixed algorithms list, the right key, audience and issuer.

pitfalls.title: TLS certificate verification disabled
pitfalls.fix: Keep verification on; supply the private CA via ca.

pitfalls.title: Math.random used for a security value
pitfalls.fix: Use crypto.randomBytes / crypto.randomUUID / crypto.getRandomValues.

pitfalls.title: Regular expression built from input (ReDoS / injection)
pitfalls.fix: Escape input (lodash.escapeRegExp) or use plain string matching; bound input length.

pitfalls.title: Session cookie without Secure/HttpOnly
pitfalls.fix: Set httpOnly, secure and sameSite=lax (or strict).

pitfalls.title: message handler without an origin check
pitfalls.fix: Check event.origin against an allow-list before using event.data.

pitfalls.title: CORS allows any or reflected origin
pitfalls.fix: Allow-list origins; never combine a reflected origin with credentials.

pitfalls.title: Prisma raw SQL from a variable: $queryRawUnsafe/$executeRawUnsafe, Prisma.raw, or $queryRaw called with a string
pitfalls.fix: Use the $queryRaw`...${value}` tagged template (values become parameters) or Prisma.sql; allow-list identifiers such as column names.

pitfalls.title: Request body passed whole to an ORM write (mass assignment): data: body or data: { ...body }
pitfalls.fix: Pick the fields the caller may set (a schema with only those fields, then data: { name: parsed.name }); never spread the body.

pitfalls.title: Redirect target checked only with startsWith('/'): '//evil.example' and '/\evil.example' pass
pitfalls.fix: Reject values starting with '//' or '/\', or parse with new URL(value, base) and require the same origin.

pitfalls.title: CSV export without formula escaping (cells starting with = + - @ run in spreadsheets)
pitfalls.fix: Prefix cells that start with =, +, -, @, tab or carriage return with a single quote, and quote every cell.

pitfalls.title: Values interpolated into a <style> block (CSS injection; </style> breaks out to HTML)
pitfalls.fix: Validate values against a strict pattern (#rrggbb colours, numbers) or set them as CSS custom properties through the style prop.

pitfalls.title: Shared-cache headers (public, s-maxage) in a handler that reads the session
pitfalls.fix: Send Cache-Control: private, no-store on responses that depend on the caller, or add Vary: Cookie.

pitfalls.title: OAuth callback reads state without comparing it with a value bound to the user's session
pitfalls.fix: Store a random state in an httpOnly cookie (or the session) before redirecting, and compare it on the callback.

pitfalls.owasp: A08:2025 Software or Data Integrity Failures
pitfalls.title: Webhook handler parses the body with no signature verification in the file
pitfalls.fix: Verify the provider's signature on the raw body (stripe.webhooks.constructEvent, svix Webhook.verify) and fail closed when the secret is unset.

pitfalls.title: Upload stored with the client's Content-Type (file.type)
pitfalls.fix: Detect the type from the bytes (magic numbers), allow-list it, and serve uploads with Content-Disposition: attachment.

pitfalls.title: Authentication bypass or extra roles controlled by an environment variable, with no environment guard
pitfalls.fix: Remove the bypass from deployed code, or accept it only when an explicit local-development setting is on and fail closed everywhere else.

pitfalls.title: multer upload handler with no size limit
pitfalls.fix: Pass limits: { fileSize, files } to multer and reject larger uploads before parsing them.

pitfalls.title: SQL built by concatenation or String.format
pitfalls.fix: Use PreparedStatement placeholders / JPA parameters; allow-list identifiers.

pitfalls.title: OS command execution
pitfalls.fix: Use a fixed executable with an argument list; never pass input through a shell.

pitfalls.owasp: A08:2025 Software or Data Integrity Failures
pitfalls.title: Unsafe deserialisation
pitfalls.fix: Avoid native deserialisation of untrusted data; use JSON with fixed types, or an ObjectInputFilter allow-list.

pitfalls.title: XML parser factory without XXE hardening
pitfalls.fix: Disable DOCTYPEs (disallow-doctype-decl) and external entities on the factory.

pitfalls.title: Weak cipher, mode or hash
pitfalls.fix: AES/GCM/NoPadding with random IVs; SHA-256+; passwords with bcrypt/argon2.

pitfalls.title: Trust-all certificates or hostname verifier
pitfalls.fix: Use the platform trust store; pin certificates with a network security config if policy requires it.

pitfalls.title: java.util.Random for a security value
pitfalls.fix: Use SecureRandom.

pitfalls.title: File path built from request input
pitfalls.fix: Normalise and check the path stays under the base directory; prefer opaque IDs.

pitfalls.title: WebView with JavaScript bridge or file access
pitfalls.fix: Load only trusted origins; avoid JavaScript bridges, or check the origin on every bridge call; disable file access.

pitfalls.owasp: A09:2025 Security Logging and Alerting Failures
pitfalls.title: Secret written to logcat
pitfalls.fix: Remove the log, or strip it from release builds.

pitfalls.title: Secret stored in plain SharedPreferences or world-readable mode
pitfalls.fix: Use EncryptedSharedPreferences / Android Keystore.

pitfalls.title: Exported component without a permission
pitfalls.fix: Set exported="false" unless needed; protect exported components with a signature permission and validate intents.

pitfalls.title: Cleartext traffic or debuggable build allowed
pitfalls.fix: Disable cleartext (network security config), debuggable and allowBackup in release.

pitfalls.title: App Transport Security disabled
pitfalls.fix: Remove the exception; scope any needed exception to one domain.

pitfalls.title: Secret stored in UserDefaults or a plain file
pitfalls.fix: Store secrets in the Keychain with an appropriate accessibility class.

pitfalls.title: Server trust accepted without evaluation
pitfalls.fix: Call SecTrustEvaluateWithError and fail closed; pin with NSPinnedDomains if policy requires it.

pitfalls.title: UIWebView or WKWebView file access from file URLs
pitfalls.fix: Use WKWebView, scope file read access to one directory, and disable universal file access.

pitfalls.title: SQL built with Sprintf or concatenation
pitfalls.fix: Use placeholders ($1 / ?); allow-list identifiers.

pitfalls.title: Command run through a shell or with variable arguments
pitfalls.fix: Run a fixed binary with separate arguments; never through a shell.

pitfalls.title: InsecureSkipVerify
pitfalls.fix: Keep verification; use RootCAs for private CAs.

pitfalls.title: File path built from request input
pitfalls.fix: Use http.FS / os.Root (Go 1.24+) or check the cleaned path stays under the base.

pitfalls.title: Escaping bypassed with template.HTML or text/template
pitfalls.fix: Use html/template and pass plain strings.

pitfalls.title: math/rand used for a security value
pitfalls.fix: Use crypto/rand.

pitfalls.title: SQL built from request input
pitfalls.fix: Use PDO/mysqli prepared statements.

pitfalls.title: Shell command with variables
pitfalls.fix: Avoid the shell; escapeshellarg is a last resort.

pitfalls.title: include/require with request input
pitfalls.fix: Map input to a fixed allow-list of files.

pitfalls.owasp: A08:2025 Software or Data Integrity Failures
pitfalls.title: unserialize of untrusted data
pitfalls.fix: Use json_decode, or allowed_classes => false.

pitfalls.title: Request input echoed without escaping
pitfalls.fix: Escape with htmlspecialchars(..., ENT_QUOTES) or use the template engine.

pitfalls.title: eval or preg_replace /e
pitfalls.fix: Remove eval; use preg_replace_callback.

pitfalls.title: SQL fragment with string interpolation
pitfalls.fix: Use hash conditions or placeholders (where("x = ?", v)); allow-list order columns.

pitfalls.title: Shell command with interpolation
pitfalls.fix: Pass arguments as a list.

pitfalls.owasp: A08:2025 Software or Data Integrity Failures
pitfalls.title: Unsafe YAML / Marshal / Oj load
pitfalls.fix: Use YAML.safe_load / JSON.

pitfalls.title: Mass assignment from params
pitfalls.fix: Use strong parameters with an explicit permit list.

pitfalls.title: Escaping bypassed (html_safe / raw)
pitfalls.fix: Escape by default; sanitize with an allow-list.

pitfalls.title: redirect_to with params
pitfalls.fix: Redirect to paths or allow-listed hosts (allow_other_host: false).

pitfalls.title: Method or class chosen from params
pitfalls.fix: Map input to an allow-list of methods/classes.

pitfalls.title: SQL built by interpolation or concatenation
pitfalls.fix: Use parameters, or FromSqlInterpolated / ExecuteSqlInterpolated.

pitfalls.owasp: A08:2025 Software or Data Integrity Failures
pitfalls.title: Unsafe .NET deserialiser
pitfalls.fix: Use System.Text.Json with fixed types; never TypeNameHandling other than None.

pitfalls.title: Process.Start with runtime arguments
pitfalls.fix: Use a fixed executable and ArgumentList; never cmd /c with input.

pitfalls.title: Certificate validation bypassed
pitfalls.fix: Remove the callback; trust private CAs via the store.

pitfalls.title: Html.Raw / MarkupString bypasses encoding
pitfalls.fix: Let Razor encode; sanitise HTML with an allow-list sanitiser.

pitfalls.title: Unbounded string copy or read
pitfalls.fix: Use bounded variants (snprintf, strlcpy) and check lengths.

pitfalls.title: Format string taken from a variable
pitfalls.fix: Always pass a literal format: printf("%s", s).

pitfalls.title: Allocation size computed by multiplication
pitfalls.fix: Use calloc or check the multiplication for overflow first.

pitfalls.title: system()/popen()
pitfalls.fix: Use execve with an argument vector.

pitfalls.owasp: A08:2025 Software or Data Integrity Failures
pitfalls.title: pull_request_target checks out and runs untrusted PR code
pitfalls.fix: Use pull_request for untrusted code, or split into an unprivileged build and a privileged workflow_run that never executes PR code.

pitfalls.title: Attacker-controlled expression in a run: script
pitfalls.fix: Pass the value through env: (TITLE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}) and use "$TITLE" in the script.

pitfalls.title: Third-party action pinned to a mutable tag
pitfalls.fix: Pin third-party actions to a full commit SHA (with the tag in a comment) and let Dependabot update it.

pitfalls.title: Workflow token with write-all permissions
pitfalls.fix: Declare least-privilege permissions per job.

pitfalls.title: Remote script piped to a shell or unverified download
pitfalls.fix: Download pinned artefacts and verify a checksum or signature.

pitfalls.title: Secret baked into an image via ENV/ARG
pitfalls.fix: Use build secrets (--mount=type=secret) and runtime injection.

pitfalls.title: Publicly readable storage or open admin port
pitfalls.fix: Block public access; restrict ingress to known ranges or a bastion/VPN.

pitfalls.title: Encryption at rest disabled
pitfalls.fix: Enable encryption with a managed key.

pitfalls.title: Data service reachable from the public internet (publicNetworkAccess Enabled)
pitfalls.fix: Disable public network access and reach the service through a private endpoint or VNet integration.

pitfalls.title: Firewall rule from 0.0.0.0: "allow all Azure services" (to 0.0.0.0) or the whole internet (to 255.255.255.255)
pitfalls.fix: Remove the rule; "allow Azure services" admits every tenant's Azure resources, not just yours. Use a private endpoint, VNet rules or specific addresses.

pitfalls.title: Database administrator password login left enabled (no Entra-only authentication)
pitfalls.fix: Use Microsoft Entra authentication only (passwordAuth Disabled, azureADOnlyAuthentication true); if a password must stay, keep it in Key Vault and rotate it.

pitfalls.title: Bicep parameter holding a secret without @secure() (logged in deployment history)
pitfalls.fix: Decorate the parameter with @secure() so it is not stored in the deployment history or outputs.

pitfalls.title: Key Vault access policy grants list/get on every secret: check which principal gets it
pitfalls.fix: Prefer RBAC (enableRbacAuthorization) with Key Vault Secrets User on the specific secrets; never grant list to compute identities or broad groups.

pitfalls.title: App Service allows plain FTP deployment (ftpsState AllAllowed)
pitfalls.fix: Set ftpsState to Disabled (or FtpsOnly) and deploy through the pipeline.

pitfalls.title: App Service without httpsOnly: plain HTTP is served
pitfalls.fix: Set httpsOnly: true on the site.

pitfalls.title: Minimum TLS version below 1.2
pitfalls.fix: Set the minimum TLS version to '1.2' (TLS1_2) or later.

pitfalls.title: Account key from listKeys() written into an app setting or connection string
pitfalls.fix: Use a managed identity with a data-plane role instead of the account key, or a Key Vault reference; keys in app settings are readable by anyone with Contributor on the site.

pitfalls.title: Pipeline triggers on every branch ('*'): anyone who can push a branch runs it with its secrets and connections
pitfalls.fix: List the branches that should build (main, release/*); keep secrets and service connections in deployment jobs behind an environment with approvals and a branch control check.

pitfalls.title: Secret-looking pipeline variable with a literal value in the YAML
pitfalls.fix: Move the value to a secret variable, a variable group linked to Key Vault, or a Key Vault task; reference it as $(name).

pitfalls.title: Secret-looking pipeline variable (- name/value form) with a literal value in the YAML
pitfalls.fix: Move the value to a secret variable, a variable group linked to Key Vault, or a Key Vault task; reference it as $(name).

pitfalls.title: Branch name, commit message, pull request field or runtime parameter pasted into a script
pitfalls.fix: Pass the value through env: (BRANCH: $(Build.SourceBranchName)) and use "$BRANCH" in the script; declare runtime parameters with a type and values: list so they cannot carry shell syntax.

pitfalls.title: Service connection used in a plain job, outside a deployment job with an environment (no approval or check)
pitfalls.fix: Run the step in a deployment job that targets an environment with approvals and checks (branch control).
